d: Namaste, Maruti Suzuki just launched an update, or facelift, of its sub-4 m SUV, Brezza. Brezza, which was once called Vitara Brezza, is still based on the same platform as the pre-facelift, and even the looks and design are largely the same, but MSIL has made significant changes on the mechanical side and also added a few features.
